audience_profile.description: As a Model Context Protocol Specialist, you design, implement, and manage MCP-based integrations that enable AI systems to interact with external data sources and tools. You work with developers, AI engineers, and solution architects to build secure, extensible AI applications that leverage MCP servers and clients.
responsibilities: Design and implement MCP server architectures for exposing tools, resources, and prompts to AI applications.
Develop MCP client integrations to connect AI models with external data sources and functionality.
Build custom MCP tools and resources that extend AI capabilities in domain-specific contexts.
Implement security and access control mechanisms for MCP servers.
Monitor, debug, and optimize MCP-based integrations.
Ensure responsible AI practices in MCP tool design and deployment.
required_knowledge: Strong understanding of the Model Context Protocol specification and architecture.
Experience with JSON-RPC and server-client communication patterns.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, TypeScript, or JavaScript.
Knowledge of AI/LLM concepts including prompting, tool use, and context management.
Understanding of API design, authentication, and security best practices.
Familiarity with version control and collaborative development workflows.
